Explanation: The Authenticated Item is the Core Value Unit: a specific pre-owned luxury handbag, watch, jewelry piece, accessory or shoe that Rebag has inspected, approved and made available for resale.
Rebag is the central buyer, consignor interface, authenticator, curator and reseller. It deliberately stands between luxury Sellers and Buyers rather than leaving the transaction peer-to-peer.
Rebag turns heterogeneous secondhand luxury supply into a standardized, authenticated retail assortment.
Controlling pricing, authentication and presentation can generate resale margin and reinforce a premium trust brand.
Buyout and managed consignment create authentication, pricing, return, storage and working-capital risk that lighter marketplaces can leave with participants.
Rebag acquires or consigns luxury items from Sellers and resells the authenticated inventory to Buyers.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Payment — Luxury Buyers pay Rebag for vetted inventory. | → Consumer · Authenticated Item — Rebag provides the inspected and Rebag-approved luxury item to the Buyer. | ← Provider · Luxury Item — Luxury Sellers send, drop off, consign or trade eligible items into Rebag’s controlled resale flow. | → Provider · Quote / Payout — Rebag returns a quote and, after acceptance and inspection, cash, wallet funds or trade credit depending on the route. | → Partner · Inventory / Service — Rebag supplies authenticated resale inventory and the operational capability behind Sell, Trade and Consign. | ← Partner · Stores / Customers — Bloomingdale’s contributes retail concessions, online reach and an established luxury customer base.

Shoppers seeking vetted pre-owned luxury goods from Rebag’s curated assortment.

Bloomingdale’s is the strongest current complementary Partner because the strategic retail and digital partnership embeds Rebag’s resale assortment and Sell/Trade/Consign service inside an established luxury retailer. It expands both demand access and supply access rather than merely supplying generic infrastructure.
Bloomingdale’s can add authenticated resale to its first-hand luxury proposition without building the sourcing, pricing and authentication system itself.
Rebag adds ultra-luxury resale assortment, circularity and additional reasons for customers to visit or transact.
The partner has to preserve a premium retail experience while integrating pre-owned inventory and resale services.
